items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: we became good friends, as good a friend as anybody was ever able to be with Duke

ctx.x: And I used to be up there, oh, three or four nights a week. And we got to talking to him, and of course I knew the guys in his band before I knew him, and we became good friends, as good a friend as anybody was ever able to be with Duke. Now, Duke, God bless him, he's a wonderful man, but very few people ever really knew where they were with Duke. I don't mean that he would put up with you if he disliked you, but there's very few people that ever really got close to Duke. He -- I think he did sort of take a…
Well, he liked you very, very much. I mean there was a closeness that I saw, but that of course was later.
